title: Bayonetta 3
description: Bayonetta 3 pushes the series into a multiverse-spanning conflict. Bayonetta can directly command Infernal Demons with Demon Slave, transform through Demon Masquerade and fight alongside new witch-in-training Viola. The campaign mixes classic combo combat with giant demon battles and cinematic set pieces.

gameplayPillars.title: Demon Slave
gameplayPillars.description: Directly command large Infernal Demons in real time to extend combos, solve encounters and battle giant enemies.

gameplayPillars.title: Demon Masquerade
gameplayPillars.description: Fuse with linked demons to transform movement and attacks with weapon-specific forms.

gameplayPillars.title: Viola
gameplayPillars.description: Play selected chapters as Viola, whose sword-and-parry combat changes the defensive rhythm.

gameplayPillars.title: Multiverse Spectacle
gameplayPillars.description: Travel across alternate realities with unique Bayonetta variants and huge cinematic battles.

worldSummary: A man-made threat known as the Homunculi attacks multiple realities. Bayonetta travels through alternate worlds, meets other versions of herself and joins Viola while confronting Singularity and a collapse that threatens the multiverse.

storyChapters.title: Homunculi Invasion
storyChapters.body: Artificial Homunculi begin destroying parallel worlds and destabilizing the multiverse.

storyChapters.title: Across the Multiverse
storyChapters.body: Bayonetta travels between alternate realities and meets different versions of herself.

storyChapters.title: Viola and Luka
storyChapters.body: Viola joins the fight while Luka’s role grows increasingly important to the multiversal crisis.

storyChapters.title: Singularity
storyChapters.body: The confrontation with Singularity escalates into a series of reality-spanning climax battles.

perfResolutionHandheld: sub-480p reported in demanding portable presentation
perfNotes: Bayonetta 3 is technically ambitious for Switch. Docked resolution reaches around 810p, portable presentation can sit below 480p, and regular gameplay targets 60 fps without maintaining a perfect lock. Cutscenes and some large-scale content run at 30 fps.

handheld.resolution: sub-480p reported in demanding portable presentation
handheld.notes: Portable rendering is substantially lower than docked and can fall just below 480p-class presentation. Gameplay still targets 60 fps but is frequently unstable.

tv.notes: Docked rendering can reach roughly 810p. Standard gameplay targets 60 fps, while cinematics and some large-scale sequences use 30 fps presentation.

storageNotes: Official/reliable listing reports approximately 14.479 GB for the Nintendo Switch download. Leave additional free space for save data and future updates.

faq.q: Does Bayonetta 3 work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes through backward compatibility where Nintendo marks the Nintendo Switch release as supported. This file does not classify it as a native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

faq.q: What language is the supplier version of Bayonetta 3?
faq.a: Supplier listing language supplied by the user: Simplified Chinese. Official/regional language details are preserved separately in supported_languages_raw and nintendo_notes so the supplier SKU is not generalized to every region.
The main game is single-player; no multiplayer mode is asserted in this file.

faq.q: Why are some Switch 2 performance resolution fields blank for Bayonetta 3?
faq.a: Because exact measured Switch 2 backward-compatibility rendering values were not verified. The template is intentionally left blank rather than filled with hardware maximums or guesses.

verdictSummary: A mechanically ambitious and spectacular action sequel with excellent combat ideas, held back mainly by the original Switch hardware’s resolution and frame-rate limits. Its Demon Slave system gives it a distinct identity within the series.
